claim_boundary.research_question: Does the frozen native one-minute pair-token iTransformer retain positive and superior out-of-sample portfolio performance relative to its matched causal fifteen-minute control on the previously unopened August 2025 through June 2026 interval?
not_authorized: changing the universe, pair axis, features, architecture, seeds, training rule, ranking map, risk engine, funding treatment, costs, refit dates, or evaluation interval after outcomes are opened
selecting a seed or refit by confirmation performance
computing confirmation IC, returns, turnover, costs, Sharpe, drawdown, attribution, or any other outcome before every required forecast is registered and sealed
calling the development runner or development evaluator directly because both are outcome-coupled and hard-bound to the June 2025 development firewall
claiming realized HFT attainability from gross or fixed-cost simulations

exact_parent_parity_required_for: economic weights, cashflow labels, and availability masks
factorized components and native/control model inputs

confirmation_interval.terminal_execution_rule: the final forecast decision is 2026-06-30 22:00 UTC; append a zero-pair-target row at the fully observed 23:00 UTC open, book any funding owed by the carried position at that boundary, close all coins there, and earn no return after the terminal row

data.universe_rule: unchanged static 2021 Top-24 axis from the frozen parent
data.unavailable_or_delisted_contract_policy: mask the affected coin and every incident pair; never replace or splice
data.terminal_boundary_requirement: no July 2026 archive or outcome is permitted; the last model decision is 2026-06-30 22:00 UTC and the already observed 2026-06-30 23:00 UTC June open is a zero-target liquidation boundary, not a prediction row
data.acquisition_and_parsing_separation: acquisition may download allowlisted files, but the preparation adapter must hard-slice formation, decision, and terminal-boundary roles before producing separated training/planning and evaluation artifacts

N02_native_1m.rule: the previous complete hour's sixty pair-residual one-minute increments in chronological order under the hedge weight in force at the start of that completed hour

C02_causal_15m_control.rule: within each of four consecutive fifteen-minute blocks, replace every increment by that block's sum divided by fifteen

target.definition: exact next-hour fixed-quantity pair cashflow including next-boundary funding and excluding carried funding at the decision boundary

walk_forward.causal_test_history_rule: a later test decision may use paths realized before that decision; these causally revealed histories are features, not same-decision forward labels

model.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of all three forecasts; never select a seed
model.loss: masked Smooth-L1 next-hour cashflow forecast loss

portfolio.mapping: frozen parent rank_pair_targets after the three-seed arithmetic mean
portfolio.funding: realized Binance funding cashflows at governed boundaries are included
portfolio.transaction_cost_formula: one-way cost equals cost_bps times traded gross divided by 10000 at every hourly action, including entry, rebalancing, and terminal liquidation

forecast_separation.evaluation_rule: the evaluator validates the complete all-fold seal before it opens or parses the separately hashed evaluation payload
forecast_separation.causal_feature_disclosure: factorized forecast inputs contain only histories available by each decision, including paths realized earlier inside the confirmation period; they contain no same-decision forward target cashflow, next-boundary funding, cost, IC, or portfolio outcome array

reporting.primary_estimand: N02 minus C02 paired daily portfolio-return difference at 0.5 bp

paired_inference.method: moving-block bootstrap of the paired daily N02-minus-C02 return difference

mandatory_metrics: hourly gross, net, beta, volatility, effective-count and concentration audits
paired daily differences and fixed-seed seven-day moving-block bootstrap
reporting.mandatory_disclosure: the 2023-2024 Sharpe 2.798 was development evidence used to select N02 and is not part of this confirmation sample
